text.text_excerpt: So glad I stayed here! We came to town and had our lodgings fall through, so a quick online search had me calling the Royal St. Charles, in a fantastic location right in the middle of just about everything for a great rate. First of all, I'm going to go against what some others have said and claim that the hotel valet and overall prices were completely fair, in my opinion. There is no where to park around the hotel because there ISN'T ANYWHERE TO PARK IN THAT PART OF NEW ORLEANS. So it's totally worth it, since I'd rather have someone else park my car than schlep my bags around in the heat. The only things I want to be carrying in New Orleans is something to drink and my girl over my shou...

We booked this hotel through Priceline, so we didn't actually know what hotel we would be staying at. We only knew that it was located very close to the French Quarter and that it was a 4 star hotel. This hotel does have a mandatory $9.95 resort fee per night, but I've found that a lot of hotels have started adding these kind of fees to their rooms. They do tell you about this as soon as you check in, so you shouldn't be alarmed to see this added to your statement at the end of your stay. We were greeted by the lovely front desk staff (Rochelle, was very helpful throughout our entire stay here. She would always greet us and remembered who we were every time she saw us). On our 10 day honeymoon, we stayed at a few hotels and Royal St. Charles was by far the best. Proximity to the French Quarter is perfect. The staff are amazing, and upgraded our room when there was a Groupon mix-up. I also was a bit sick on the trip, and the front desk staff treated me with so much kindness. Yes, the bathrooms are a little small.. but who cares? Awesome water pressure. CLEAN rooms. Beyond comfy beds! Would stay here again in a heartbeat. And as some people have mentioned, yes.. parking is about $30 (as is anywhere you go in NOLA).. and they have a daily hotel fee of $13. Well, they are also one of the cheapest hotels in the best location so who cares about that little fee...
